title: DISABLED test_select_SparseBSC_int32_cuda_float16 (__main__.TestSparseCSRCUDA)
bug_description:
Platforms: rocm

This test is being disabled because it is flaky in the CI - fails with SIGIOT and causes other tests that ran before it to go missing in the xml files e.g. https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17878773089/job/50844365436. This complicates efforts to assess unit test parity on upstream CI.
